# Shahab — Branding & Design (Abdullah Shahab)

> Human-designed logo design and brand identity design by Abdullah Shahab, a brand identity designer with 7 years of experience and 46+ brand identities. First brand board in 48 hours. Fixed packages: Basic $250, Premium Branding $450, The Brand Ecosystem $1,050. Clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and the UAE.
